newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: DBS Bank sees slower property loans.
newsitem.headline: DBS Bank sees slower property loans.

text.p: The Development Bank of Singapore Ltd said on Thursday it expects slower loans to the Singapore property sector in the second half of 1997.

DBS Bank President Ng Kee Choe told reporters at a briefing after the release of 1996 results that measures the government instituted in May 1996 to dampen speculation in the property sector would have an effect on the housing loan market, but that effect was not seen in 1996.
"We do not expect to see that until the second half of 1997," he said.
However, Ng added that he expected this weaker demand for housing loans "to be more than compensated for by growth in other areas."
